## Vault.read() method

Read a plaintext file that is stored inside the vault, directly from disk. Use this if you intend to modify the file content afterwards. Use [Vault.cachedRead()](cachedRead.md) otherwise for better performance.

 0.9.7

**Signature:**

```typescript
read(file: TFile): Promise<string>;
```
